title: Fix vendor contact relation read permission
summary: The VendCont-Update codeunit now elevates read permission to Contact Business Relation during vendor modification, allowing contact synchronization logic to execute properly without users needing additional direct permissions.
key_points: VendCont-Update codeunit now grants itself read permission to Contact Business Relation table
Fixes vendor contact relation updates that previously failed due to missing read permissions
Aligns permission pattern with existing CustCont-Update and BankCont-Update codeunits
No changes to contact synchronization behavior or user-facing functionality
Low-risk metadata correction following established permission elevation patterns
